note: Paths read with either separator (register decision 247). Each mutant takes away the reading of one separator and is judged by its script's self-test, which holds a tree written with backslashes as well as one written with forward slashes, and by the real check on this tree. Since M1-109 (register decision 392) a Python mutant names no build target, and the harness builds nothing for it; until then every mutant named orbsim_shaders as a no-op, which made every shader an input of this file.
